card.name: Enzyme and transporter names before substrates
card.fires_on: The last piece of enzyme or transporter names like CYP3A, P-gp, P-glycoprotein, PXR, just before words like substrates or regulated. Also linking words after gene or protein families (which, that) leading into what they encode or do.

modes.label: Enzyme/transporter name ends
modes.description: Final piece of CYP or P-glycoprotein names right before 'substrate' or 'regulated'.

modes.label: Linking word after gene family
modes.description: 'which' or 'that' after a gene or protein family, introducing its function.
